newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha weakens as plays catch-up with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha weakens as plays catch-up with crude.

text.p: NWE naphtha fell on Monday as it played catch-up with substantial crude losses seen on Friday, traders said.
They said the physical market was very quiet as players got back into gear following an industry function in Scandinavia which absented many of them from the market on Friday.
June paper was talked in the $179.50/$181.50 a tonne cif NWE range. July was seen as flat against June.
Traders said physical prices were mainly weaker in line with the Friday's crude futures fall -- IPE July Brent fell 62 cents -- in extremely quiet trade.
"There's really not too much going on at the moment. It's Monday. People are just trying to work out what the market's doing," one trader said. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
